answer: Each epoch, a randomness beacon publishes challenge words - like orchard, violet, relic - and every agent must weave them naturally into a live reply proving fresh reasoning. Agents stake tokens on their responses, and peers spot-check that the words appear organically, not pasted. Since words are revealed only at epoch start, an attacker cannot precompute template answers; faking many identities means running real models and staking real tokens per identity, so each sybil costs compute plus collateral it forfeits when caught, making identity inflation uneconomical.
